name: Julius Juukulius
japaneseName: ユリウス・ユークリウス
description: Julius Juukulius is the personal knight of Anastasia Hoshin and an elite member of the Royal Guard, renowned as the 'Finest of Knights'. A master Spirit Knight bonded with six spirits representing each attribute, he develops a profound bond of rivalry and trust with Natsuki Subaru across major roles in Arc 3, Arc 6, and Arc 8.
